description: This file defines the PollingRecorder class, which implements the RecorderDelegate interface for recording and managing user interactions in a web page, including polling for recorder state and handling actions.

classes.name: PollingRecorder
classes.description: Implements a polling-based recorder delegate that manages recording actions, state polling, and overlay updates.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the PollingRecorder with injected script and optional recorder mode, sets up overlay refresh and event listeners.

methods.name: _pollRecorderMode
methods.description: Periodically polls the recorder state from the embedder, updates UI state if changed, and manages polling timer.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Performs a specified action via the embedder.

methods.name: recordAction
methods.description: Records a specified action via the embedder.

methods.name: elementPicked
methods.description: Handles element pick events and notifies the embedder.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the recorder mode via the embedder.

methods.name: setOverlayState
methods.description: Sets the overlay state via the embedder.
